player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaiwhakatākaro {player_id} e tākaro ana i te {colour} ({piece}) i te kēmu o Othello.
Ko tō whāinga kia nui ake ō papa ki runga i te papa i te mutunga o te kēmu.
I tō wā, whakatakotoria he papa kia rārangi ki tētahi, ki ētahi rānei o ngā papa a tō hoa-whawhai i ngā ahunga katoa (whakaroto, poutū, whakapiko rānei) - i waenganui i tō papa hou me tētahi atu o āu papa kua noho. Ka hurihia ngā papa katoa a tō hoa-whawhai ki tō tae.
Tukua tō neke i te tauira '[row, col]'.
